{{Quote|<nowiki />''Goopa'', Latara.''"<br />"''We're going to look at Paploo's new raft. Wanna come along?|[[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa]], [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket]], [[Paploo/Legends|Paploo]] and [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] inviting [[Latara/Legends|Latara]] for fun|<ref name="The Travelling Jindas">{{Ewoks|The Travelling Jindas}}</ref>}}
A '''raft''' was a flat floating structure for travel over [[Water/Legends|water]]. It could be used to carry passengers and freight. 

Sometimes, the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] ran across the [[Endor/Legends|Endorian]] rivers on board rafts. The young ladies [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]] and her friend [[Latara/Legends|Latara]] sometimes ran on board a raft, when they had no chores to do.<ref name="1x03">{{Ewoks|Rampage of the Phlogs}}</ref>

On one occasion, Princess Kneesaa, [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]], and Latara used a raft to search for their friend [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]], who went alone to fight a [[hanadak]], an Endorian predatory primates.<ref name="2x09">{{Ewoks|Gone With the Mimphs}}</ref>

In 22 ABY, Jedi trainees [[Anakin Solo]] and [[Tahiri Veila]], along with [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], used a metal raft to travel to the [[Palace of the Woolamander]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. The children were guided by a prophetic [[Dream/Legends|dream]], along with [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathic]] communication from the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ikrit]]. Due to a powerful storm that quickly rose while they were on the water, the two risked drowning but were saved by R2-D2 and their own burgeoning powers.<ref name="Junior Jedi Knights: The Golden Globe">''[[Junior Jedi Knights: The Golden Globe]]''</ref>
